create_tabular_params_instance: create a TabularParams instance with data_path and model settings for tabular training
configure_tabular_model: configure TabularParams to use lightgbm instead of xgboost for tabular data
set_tabular_task: set the task attribute on TabularParams to regression for a regression problem
configure_hyperparameter_trials: configure num_trials and time_limit on TabularParams for hyperparameter optimization
set_column_mapping: set target_columns categorical_columns and numerical_columns on TabularParams for column mapping
